card.name: Ending of medication and premedicate
card.fires_on: The final piece of the word "medication" or "premedicate" after the split-off "Medic", "med" or "Premed". It appears in label sections on premedication and Medication Guides.

modes.label: Premedicate
modes.description: The ending "icate" after "Pre-med" in instructions to give antihistamines or steroids beforehand.

modes.label: Medication
modes.description: The ending "ation" after "Medic" or "Premed" in headings and sentences about medication.
